summary: Frontend-only i18n verification across DE/EN/RU/UA for About, Contact, Energy-Calculator, and CookieBanner — all PASS. Plus regression: Shop, ProductDetail, Footer, Header in all 4 languages. Language switcher persists via localStorage 'ecobt_lang_v1'. Cookie banner accept writes 'ecobt_cookie_ack_v1=1' and disappears in EN/RU/UA. Contact form submission produces success view in active language (verified EN). All translation keys resolve (no raw 'about.xxx' / 'contact.xxx' / 'calc.xxx' leaks). Energy calculator interactions update result panel correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: I18nContext.jsx dictionary is 250+ lines inline in the provider file. As it grows it should be split into /context/i18n/{de,en,ru,uk}.json (or per-namespace files) and loaded lazily. Currently fine for scale (~120 keys).

useT() helper (lines 289-292) returns an empty string when given a dict missing both lang and DE keys — silently swallows mistakes. Consider warning in dev mode or returning the key path like t() does.

calc.type.passivSub uses a single space ' ' as placeholder content in all 4 langs to preserve layout. Works but is a UI hack — consider conditional rendering: `{sub &&
{sub}
}`.
Contact.jsx success state and form share the same lg:col-span-7 container but no aria-live region — screen readers won't announce the success transition.

CookieBanner.jsx 'X' close button and 'Read privacy policy' link both call accept() — clicking close implicitly grants consent which is misleading. cookie.readMore should ideally route to /datenschutz instead of also writing ack.
seed_data_creation: Submitted 1 contact via /kontakt form with name='Test User', email='test@example.com', message='i18n test'. Will appear in admin Kontakte tab.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Note: Many UI elements (nav links, eyebrows, btn-primary labels) use CSS text-transform: uppercase. Case-sensitive assertions on rendered .innerText will read UPPERCASE even though dictionary stores PascalCase ('Got it' → 'GOT IT'). Use .lower() comparisons when verifying i18n strings. localStorage keys: 'ecobt_lang_v1' (DE/EN/RU/UA), 'ecobt_cookie_ack_v1' (=1 after accept), 'ecobt_admin_token' (admin auth). Test data-testids available: lang-de/en/ru/ua, cookie-banner, cookie-accept, cookie-close, cookie-readmore, about-page, about-cta, contact-page, contact-form, contact-name/email/phone/message/submit, contact-success, contact-new, energy-calculator, calc-type-{altbau|neubau|kfw|passiv}, calc-source-{strom|gas|oel|waermepumpe}, calc-area-slider, calc-heatload, calc-kwh, calc-current, calc-wp, calc-saving.
rca of the issue: No issues found. All 4-language i18n on About/Contact/Energy/CookieBanner pages working as specified. Regression on Shop/ProductDetail/Footer/Header still green.
